cards.title: Strategic Opportunity & Market Impact
cards.botDialogue: Welcome! I am Aayam. Let's look at the strategic business opportunity for Product Cost Simulator - S/4HANA Tender & Margin Intelligence. Here is how we transform operational velocity.
bullets: Multi-week quotation latency: Cross-functional teams spend 10-18 days manually consolidating multi-level BOMs, outdated purchase info records, and work center rates.
Volatile commodity & FX risk blindness: Unanticipated price shifts in steel, copper, energy tariffs, and foreign exchange erode projected tender margins by 8-15% post-award.

Rigid ERP costing structures: Core SAP S/4HANA CK11N/CK40N costing runs are static, require released master data, and cannot run dynamic pre-deal "what-if" simulations without risking productive costing data integrity.

cards.title: Enterprise Process Bottlenecks
cards.botDialogue: Examining the core friction points in current operations. Notice the process bottlenecks that create revenue leakage.
bullets: Disconnected data silos across regional plants and commercial entities.
High variance between physical operations and digital ledger postings.
Heavy developer dependency on proprietary legacy custom code.

cards.title: End-to-End Execution Flow
cards.botDialogue: Notice our 3-step automated flow. From transaction intake to verified settlement, the process is fast and auditable.

steps.title: 1. Multi-Tier BOM & Routing Sync - Ingests multi-level Bills of Materials (BOM) and production routings from SAP S/4HANA alongside custom engineered variants without touching core tables.
steps.desc: 1. Multi-Tier BOM & Routing Sync - Ingests multi-level Bills of Materials (BOM) and production routings from SAP S/4HANA alongside custom engineered variants without touching core tables.

steps.title: 2. Live Cost Component Rollup - Dynamically rolls up material valuation (MBEW), latest purchase info records (EINA/EINE), work center activity rates, and scrap factors.
steps.desc: 2. Live Cost Component Rollup - Dynamically rolls up material valuation (MBEW), latest purchase info records (EINA/EINE), work center activity rates, and scrap factors.

steps.title: 3. What-If Simulation & Bid Guardrail Posting - Simulates raw material/FX shock scenarios, evaluates target bid margin thresholds, and pushes approved pricing directly to S/4HANA Sales Quotations.
